seed_plan.rule_summary: Parameterized replay contract: NQ long only; 4h FVG plus 1h FVA context; opposing resistance/2CR rejection high must be run; execute the first-party 15m 2-Sting entry family using only a preregistered fill convention; anchor risk to the relevant bullish Order Flow leg low using only a preregistered tick buffer; target the documented next HTF premium-array/ATH context; if the required parameter is not met in the configured opportunity window, do nothing and move on.

calibratable_parameters.name: second_sting_fill_event
calibratable_parameters.semantic_role: Operationalizes the exact executable event after the first-party-required second sting without changing the 2-Sting entry family.

calibratable_parameters.name: stop_buffer_ticks
calibratable_parameters.semantic_role: Operationalizes order placement around the first-party Order Flow leg-low stop anchor without changing that anchor.

objective.predeclared_measure: Replay each preregistered execution convention only on occurrences of the locked NQ seed and record deterministic entry observability, missed qualifying continuations, stop-anchor violations, and unresolved cases. Do not compare semantic candidates or introduce concepts after outcomes are visible.
objective.acceptance_rule: Freeze one execution convention per calibratable parameter only from the preregistered candidate set. Prefer deterministic observability and the narrowest convention consistent with the first-party semantic anchor; ties or contradictory evidence remain unresolved and fail closed. Holdout data remains untouched until after the calibrated spec is frozen and independently reconstructed.
